lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਓ ਹਮ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਚਰਨ ਪਖੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur parasaadee har naam dhiaaio ham satigur charan pakhe ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: By Guru's Grace, I meditate on the Name of the Lord; I wash the Feet of the True Guru. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਊਤਮ ਜਗੰਨਾਥ ਜਗਦੀਸੁਰ ਹਮ ਪਾਪੀ ਸਰਨਿ ਰਖੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ootam jaga(n)naath jagadeesur ham paapee saran rakhe ||
lines.translation: The Exalted Lord of the World, the Master of the Universe, keeps a sinner like me in His Sanctuary

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਮ ਵਡ ਪੁਰਖ ਦੀਨ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ ਹਰਿ ਦੀਓ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੁਖੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: tum vad purakh deen dukh bha(n)jan har deeo naam mukhe ||1||
lines.translation: You are the Greatest Being, Lord, Destroyer of the pains of the meek; You have placed Your Name in my mouth, Lord. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਊਚ ਨੀਚ ਹਮ ਗਾਏ ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਖੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: har gun ooch neech ham gaae gur satigur sa(n)g sakhe ||
lines.translation: I am lowly, but I sing the Lofty Praises of the Lord, meeting with the Guru, the True Guru, my Friend.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਚੰਦਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਸੈ ਨਿੰਮੁ ਬਿਰਖਾ ਗੁਨ ਚੰਦਨ ਕੇ ਬਸਖੇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jiu cha(n)dan sa(n)g basai ni(n)m birakhaa gun cha(n)dan ke basakhe ||2||
lines.translation: Like the bitter nimm tree, growing near the sandalwood tree, I am permeated with the fragrance of sandalwood. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਮਰੇ ਅਵਗਨ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਬਿਖੈ ਕੇ ਬਹੁ ਬਾਰ ਬਾਰ ਨਿਮਖੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: hamare avagan bikhiaa bikhai ke bahu baar baar nimakhe ||
lines.translation: My faults and sins of corruption are countless; over and over again, I commit them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਵਗਨਿਆਰੇ ਪਾਥਰ ਭਾਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਤਾਰੇ ਸੰਗਿ ਜਨਖੇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: avaganiaare paathar bhaare har taare sa(n)g janakhe ||3||
lines.translation: I am unworthy, I am a heavy stone sinking down; but the Lord has carried me across, in association with His humble servants. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਤੁਮ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਭ ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਪਾਪ ਕ੍ਰਿਖੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin kau tum har raakhahu suaamee sabh tin ke paap krikhe ||
lines.translation: Those whom You save, Lord - all their sins are destroyed.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਦਇਆਲ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤੁਮ ਦੁਸਟ ਤਾਰੇ ਹਰਣਖੇ ॥੪॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: jan naanak ke daiaal prabh suaamee tum dusat taare haranakhe ||4||3||
lines.translation: O Merciful God, Lord and Master of servant Nanak, You have carried across even evil villains like Harnaakhash. ||4||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਟ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: nat mahalaa 4 ||
lines.translation: Nat, Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਰੰਗੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: mere man jap har har raam ra(n)ge ||
lines.translation: O my mind, chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, with love.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੀ ਜਗਦੀਸੁਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਓ ਜਨ ਪਗਿ ਲਗੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: har har kripaa karee jagadeesur har dhiaaio jan pag lage ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: When the Lord of the Universe, Har, Har, granted His Grace, then I fell at the feet of the humble, and I meditate on the Lord. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਭੂਲ ਚੂਕ ਹਮ ਅਬ ਆਏ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਨਗੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: janam janam ke bhool chook ham ab aae prabh saranage ||
lines.translation: Mistaken and confused for so many past lives, I have now come and entered the Sanctuary of God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਮ ਸਰਣਾਗਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਕ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹਮ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਵਡ ਪਾਪਗੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: tum saranaagat pratipaalak suaamee ham raakhahu vad paapage ||1||
lines.translation: O my Lord and Master, You are the Cherisher of those who come to Your Sanctuary. I am such a great sinner - please save me! ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਮਰੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਕੋ ਨ ਉਧਰਿਓ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀਏ ਪਤਿਤ ਪਵਗੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: tumaree sa(n)gat har ko ko na udhario prabh keee patit pavage ||
lines.translation: Associating with You, Lord, who would not be saved? Only God sanctifies the sinners.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਤ ਛੀਪਾ ਦੁਸਟਾਰਿਓ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਰਾਖੀ ਪੈਜ ਜਨਗੇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: gun gaavat chheepaa dusataario prabh raakhee paij janage ||2||
lines.translation: Naam Dayv, the calico printer, was driven out by the evil villains, as he sang Your Glorious Praises; O God, You protected the honor of Your humble servant. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤੁਮਰੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹਉ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਤਿਨਗੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo tumare gun gaavahi suaamee hau bal bal bal tinage ||
lines.translation: Those who sing Your Glorious Praises, O my Lord and Master - I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice, a sacrifice to them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਵਨ ਭਵਨ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਸਭਿ ਕੀਏ ਜਹ ਧੂਰਿ ਪਰੀ ਜਨ ਪਗੇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: bhavan bhavan pavitr sabh keee jah dhoor paree jan page ||3||
lines.translation: Those houses and homes are sanctified, upon which the dust of the feet of the humble settles. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਮਰੇ ਗੁਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਹਿ ਹਮ ਤੁਮ ਵਡ ਵਡ ਪੁਰਖ ਵਡਗੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: tumare gun prabh kahi na sakahi ham tum vad vad purakh vadage ||
lines.translation: I cannot describe Your Glorious Virtues, God; You are the greatest of the great, O Great Primal Lord God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਦਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਧਾਰਹੁ ਹਮ ਸੇਵਹ ਤੁਮ ਜਨ ਪਗੇ ॥੪॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: jan naanak kau daiaa prabh dhaarahu ham sevah tum jan page ||4||4||
lines.translation: Please shower Your Mercy upon servant Nanak, God; I serve at the feet of Yor humble servants. ||4||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਟ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: nat mahalaa 4 ||
lines.translation: Nat, Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: mere man jap har har naam mane ||
lines.translation: O my mind, believe in and chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਗੰਨਾਥਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਧਾਰੀ ਮਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਮ ਬਨੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaga(n)naath kirapaa prabh dhaaree mat guramat naam bane ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: God, the Master of the Universe, has showered His Mercy upon me, and through the Guru's Teachings, my intellect has been molded by the Naam. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਇਓ ਉਪਦੇਸਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰ ਸੁਨੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: har jan har jas har har gaaio upades guroo gur sune ||
lines.translation: The Lord's humble servant sings the Praises of the Lord, Har, Har, listening to the Guru's Teachings.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਪਾਪ ਨਾਮ ਹਰਿ ਕਾਟੇ ਜਿਵ ਖੇਤ ਕ੍ਰਿਸਾਨਿ ਲੁਨੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: kilabikh paap naam har kaate jiv khet krisaan lune ||1||
lines.translation: The Lord's Name cuts down all sins, like the farmer cutting down his crops. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਮਰੀ ਉਪਮਾ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜਾਨਹੁ ਹਮ ਕਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: tumaree upamaa tum hee prabh jaanahu ham kahi na sakahi har gune ||
lines.translation: You alone know Your Praises, God; I cannot even describe Your Glorious Virtues, Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਤੁਮ ਤੈਸੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਗੁਨ ਜਾਨਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪੁਨੇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jaise tum taise prabh tum hee gun jaanahu prabh apune ||2||
lines.translation: You are what You are, God; You alone know Your Glorious Virtues, God. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਫਾਸ ਬੰਧ ਬਹੁ ਬੰਧੇ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿਓ ਖੁਲ ਖੁਲਨੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaiaa phaas ba(n)dh bahu ba(n)dhe har japio khul khulane ||
lines.translation: The mortals are bound by the many bonds of Maya's noose. Meditating on the Lord, the knot is untied,

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਜਲ ਕੁੰਚਰੁ ਤਦੂਐ ਬਾਂਧਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਚੇਤਿਓ ਮੋਖ ਮੁਖਨੇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: jiu jal ku(n)char tadooai baa(n)dhio har chetio mokh mukhane ||3||
lines.translation: like the elephant, which was caught in the water by the crococile; it remembered the Lord, and chanted the Lord's Name, and was released. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਆਮੀ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਤੁਮ ਖੋਜਹੁ ਜੁਗ ਜੁਗਨੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: suaamee paarabraham paramesar tum khojahu jug jugane ||
lines.translation: O my Lord and Master, Supreme Lord God, Transcendent Lord, throughout the ages, mortals search for You.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਮਰੀ ਥਾਹ ਪਾਈ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਵੈ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਵਡਨੇ ॥੪॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: tumaree thaah paaee nahee paavai jan naanak ke prabh vadane ||4||5||
lines.translation: Your extent cannot be estimated or known, O Great God of servant Nanak. ||4||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਟ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: nat mahalaa 4 ||
lines.translation: Nat, Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਕਲਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਵਣੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: mere man kal keerat har pravane ||
lines.translation: O my mind, in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises is worthy and commendable.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਇਆਲਿ ਦਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਧਾਰੀ ਲਗਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਣੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: har har daiaal daiaa prabh dhaaree lag satigur har japane ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: When the Merciful Lord God shows kindness and compassion, then one falls at the feet of the True Guru, and meditates on the Lord. ||1||Pause||
